name: io.github.mglbagi/agent-output-verifier
title: Agent Output Verifier
description: Independently verify an agent's output before you pay.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.payment: x402 (USDC on Base and Solana). verify_schema and get_verification_record each carry their own free-trial allowance per caller; after that, each call requires an x402 payment in the MCP request's _meta under "x402/payment". Exact prices, networks and the pay-to address are in the agent-card.
